title: SWF compile: ShapeDisplayObject blend mode never encoded (always PlaceObject2)
description: compile.ts handles ShapeDisplayObject in its own code path (lines ~1664-1735) but never checks the blendMode field and always emits PlaceObject2. SymbolInstance correctly emits PlaceObject3 when blendMode is set. Fix: in the ShapeDisplayObject emit path, check if blendMode is set (and non-default); if so, emit PlaceObject3 instead of PlaceObject2, encoding the blend mode byte in the same way as the SymbolInstance path. The ShapeDisplayObject blendMode field is already in types.ts (engine/types.ts lines ~309-312).
